scope: Approval proposal only. No adoption of production frames, PCB, case or viewer.
original_request: Exact colors, paths and dimensions before approval and literal transfer to future 3D files, preserving all eleven styles.

independent_review.decision: Both recommend proposal-only presentation/sync; neither selects a cover or accepts fabrication.

material_findings_and_disposition.z_schedule_ambiguity: Resolved with disjoint XY zones and explicit Z intervals per A/B; B raises entire face and case.
material_findings_and_disposition.hex_vs_role_ambiguity: Resolved with stable-role comparison even when palettes reuse HEX.
material_findings_and_disposition.ten_unannotated_styles: Resolved with ten additional dimensioned sheets and analytic feature bounds.
material_findings_and_disposition.historical_level_stack_export_digest: Deferred to production-rebuild provenance reconciliation. Native current geometry directly read for this proposal.

remaining.decision: Approve artwork master and choose A/B or request changes.
remaining.after_approval_acceptance: Extruded native geometry, exported materials and viewer must match the approved role regions and full assembly clearances; physical print/solder qualification stays separate.

bounded_retrospective.trigger: User rejected undimensioned mockups and visually divergent CAD.
bounded_retrospective.cause: Previous artwork followed a backing mask and composition adjustments without a dimensioned approval master.
bounded_retrospective.prevention: Use one exact path source for approval SVG and editable planar CAD; prohibit silent scaling, clipping and composition edits during extrusion.
bounded_retrospective.new_check: Analytic path extrema avoid misleading dimensions from coarse native display bounding boxes.
